“蛋子，什么情况？那脏东西呢？”郭云涛一脸疑惑地问道，眼神在客厅里来回扫视，却什么都没看到。

吴姜指了指地上被捆缚的男鬼和跪在地上的女鬼，笑着说道：“就在这儿呢，你们看不见而已。”

说着，他又叮嘱道，“你们就在家里等着吧，我出去一趟，很快就回来。”

他要去会会那个鬼道人，在阴差守则里，这种操控鬼物、谋财害命的邪修，是必须要抓捕的，而且抓捕成功后，奖励还十分丰厚。

李月芽脸上露出一副担忧的神色，刚想开口叫住他，但最后还是忍住了，没有开口。

吴姜来到门外，从口袋里掏出一张镇宅符，贴在了大门上，防止再有其他邪祟上门。

做完这一切，他才转头对女鬼说道：“走吧，带路，带我去找你们主人，敢耍花样，我立马让你魂飞魄散。”

女鬼不敢多言，乖乖的带路。

至于男鬼，已经被他用一个瓶子封印起来了，和墨市那个茅山前辈封印恶鬼的手段，如出一辙，只是封印用的符箓不一样。

吴姜跟在女鬼身后，一路朝着村子边缘走去，很快，就来到了一个偏僻的院子前面。

院子里杂草丛生，吴姜都不敢相信，寸土寸金的鹿城，还有这么一个废弃的院子没有开发。

吴姜刚靠近院子，就察觉到了里面一间小平房里，传来一道诡异的气息，这种气息，他还是第一次感受到。

那气息既不是他修炼的鬼气，也不是云川那种道士修炼的灵气，让他想起上次云川跟他介绍过的，一些邪修修炼的魔气。

他刚将女鬼收了起来，准备开门进入院子，一个满脸阴翳的老头，已经从院子里走了出来。

“是你？抓了我养的小鬼？”

老头满脸皱纹，眼神阴鸷，身上穿着一件破旧不堪的道袍，声音沙哑刺耳，很有一副邪道巨擘的架势。

吴姜上下打量了他一番，瞬间松了口气，心里暗自吐槽：我还以为“鬼道人”这么有逼格的外号，会是一个多难以对付的角色，没想到居然是个半截身子入土的老头，看他身上的气息，也就和云川那个小道士差不多。

正好，今天就拿这个鬼道人试试自己从《幽冥炼魂诀》里刚学会的高级术法。

"Danzi, what's going on? Where's the dirty thing?" Guo Yuntao asked with a puzzled look on his face, his eyes scanning back and forth in the living room, but he didn't see anything.

Wu Jiang pointed to the bound male ghost and the female ghost kneeling on the ground, and said with a smile: "It's right here, you can't see it."

After that, he warned, "Just wait at home. I'll go out and be back soon."

He was going to meet the ghost Taoist. According to the code of evil, such evil cultivators who manipulate ghosts and seek wealth and harm must be caught, and if the arrest is successful, the reward will be very generous.

Li Yueya had a worried look on her face and was about to call him out, but in the end she held back and did not speak.

Wu Jiang came to the door, took out a house security talisman from his pocket, and stuck it on the door to prevent other evil spirits from coming to the door.

After doing all this, he turned to the female ghost and said: "Let's go, lead the way, take me to your master, if you dare to play tricks, I will immediately make your soul fly away."

The female ghost didn't dare to say anything and just led the way obediently.

As for the male ghost, he has already sealed it with a bottle. It is exactly the same as the method used by the senior Maoshan in Moshi to seal the evil ghost, but the sealing talisman is different.

Wu Jiang followed the female ghost and walked towards the edge of the village. Soon, he came to a remote yard.

The yard was overgrown with weeds, and Wu Jiang couldn't believe that there was such an abandoned yard that had not been developed in Lucheng, where every inch of land was at a premium.

As soon as Wu Jiang approached the courtyard, he noticed a strange aura coming from a small bungalow inside. This was the first time he felt this aura.

The aura was neither the ghost aura he cultivated nor the aura cultivated by Taoist priests like Yunchuan. It reminded him of the demonic aura cultivated by some evil cultivators that Yunchuan had introduced to him last time.

He had just put away the female ghost and was about to open the door and enter the yard when an old man with a gloomy face had already walked out of the yard.

"Is it you? Caught my little brat?"

The old man's face was wrinkled, his eyes were sinister, he was wearing a shabby Taoist robe, his voice was hoarse and harsh, and he looked like a giant of evil.

Wu Jiang looked him up and down, breathed a sigh of relief, and secretly complained in his heart: I thought that "Ghost Taoist" would be a difficult character to deal with with such a powerful nickname, but I didn't expect that he turned out to be an old man who was half buried in the ground. Judging from the aura on his body, he was similar to that little Taoist priest in Yunchuan.

It just so happens that today I will use this ghost Taoist to try the advanced technique I just learned from the "Netherworld Soul Refining Technique".
